what: The Receipt Generator makes a professional receipt as proof of payment. Add your business details and logo, the customer, the items, tax and how they paid, and a live preview shows the finished receipt.
Download it as a real PDF with searchable text, or print it. Receipt numbers go up automatically, and your business details are kept for next time on this device.
uses: Give a proper receipt for cash or card sales.
Show parts, labour and payment method.
tutorial: Type your business name and address or contact details, and add a logo if you like.
The receipt number is filled in for you. Set the date, the customer’s name and optional details, the currency, paper size and accent colour.
Type each item with quantity and price. Use + Add item for more rows.
Type a discount percent and tax rate. Choose whether your prices already include tax.
Pick the payment method, add a reference such as the last four card digits, and type the amount received if it differs from the total.
Check the preview, then press Download PDF or Print. Press New receipt for the next sale.
features: See the receipt as you type.
Your logo and accent colour on every receipt.
Shows balance due or change given.

example.title: Worked example: a café sale with 16% tax
example.text: Two bags of coffee at 1,250.50 and a mug at 400 make a subtotal of 2,901.00. A 10% discount takes off 290.10, leaving 2,610.90, and 16% tax adds 417.74 for a total of 3,028.64. The customer pays 5,000 in cash, so the receipt shows change given of 1,971.36 and “Paid in full”.

tips: Add your tax number in the business details if your country requires it.
Use the payment reference to match receipts with bank records.
Press Save draft to keep your business details ready for next time.
Keep a copy of every PDF for your accounts.
problems: Some letters show as "?" in the PDF
A few scripts are not in the PDF font. Use Print and choose Save as PDF to keep them.
Very large logos may not fit in browser storage. Use a smaller picture.
